notes: Read all 70 source lines line by line before editing. Preserved the named-exported Spinner component and its public contract: the SpinnerProps shape (size 'sm'|'md'|'lg' default 'md', label?, lines 4-8, 32), the size lookup (lines 33), and the reduced-motion branch (line 34) all carry over with identical semantics; the doc comment intent (lines 16-31) is retained in the header banner and component JSDoc.

sizeMap (lines 10-14): ported verbatim as `sizeMap`/`spinnerSizeMap` keeping the sm/md/lg pixels (24/48/80) and stroke (22/14/10) pairs. pixels drive the bolt container (boxStyles) and glyph font size (boltSizeStyles) 1:1 with the web h-6/h-12/h-20 boxes; `stroke` was the SVG line thickness which has no per-glyph analogue, so it is retained for documentation and the bolt always renders bold — explicitly noted in code.

No react-native-svg exists in apps/native, so the SVG lightning <path> (lines 43-65, d='M112 30L62 108...') becomes the high-voltage glyph U+26A1 (⚡) in an Animated.Text — the same glyph-marker precedent as the ErrorBoundary parity port. The white bolt fill (text-white / fill+stroke currentColor, lines 50,55,59) maps to colors.textPrimary, and the `.spinner-bolt-glow` two-layer cyan(#22d3ee)+emerald(#10b981) drop-shadow stack (index.css) collapses to a single cyan textShadow (colors.accent) because RN Text exposes only one shadow.

The draw animation (line 50 `.spinner-bolt-glow`, line 63 `.spinner-bolt-draw` -> CSS `boltDraw 2s ease-in-out infinite`, plus pathLength=100 / strokeDasharray=100 / strokeDashoffset=100, lines 54,61,62) has no stroke-dash equivalent without SVG, so the draw->fill->hold->fade->redraw cadence is approximated by a single native-driver value looping over ~2s (DRAW 520 + HOLD 760 + FADE 520 + REDRAW_GAP 200) driving opacity plus a subtle 0.94->1 scale, preserving period and shape.

Reduced motion: `useMotionPreference()` (lines 2,34, framer-motion's useReducedMotion) becomes a native useReduceMotion() backed by AccessibilityInfo.isReduceMotionEnabled + reduceMotionChanged. `reduce` keeps identical meaning — the bolt holds fully filled (Animated.Value 1, no loop), mirroring the web reduce branch fillOpacity={1}/strokeDasharray='none'/strokeDashoffset=0/no draw class (lines 60-63).

Layout + class handling: `cn('flex flex-col items-center gap-3', className)` (lines 1,37-38) becomes styles.root (flexDirection column, alignItems center, gap spacing.md=12 for gap-3) merged with an optional `style` passthrough that replaces the web `className` prop (lines 7,38). The relative centered box wrapper (line 42) maps to styles.box over boxStyles[size]. The visible label span `text-sm text-[var(--text-secondary)]` (line 67) maps to AppText with fontSize 14 / colors.textSecondary and is still gated on `label` truthiness.

Accessibility: role='status' + aria-label (lines 39-40) map to an accessible View with accessibilityRole='progressbar' and accessibilityLiveRegion='polite', keeping the same default 'Loading' label; the SVG aria-hidden='true' (line 49) maps to accessibilityElementsHidden + importantForAccessibility='no-hide-descendants' on the bolt. xmlns/viewBox/fill='none' SVG plumbing (lines 46-48) is intrinsic to SVG and has no native counterpart. No DOM elements, react-native-svg, Recharts, Leaflet, framer-motion, or web UI components are imported.
